purpose: Confirmatory evidence on a held-out target chosen before inspecting results (reviewer R2-B). Dev-set K1 estimates are reported separately as development-set evidence.

budget.note: identical for every arm -- matched stopping contract (R2-A, R1-I)

scoring.success_rule: objective success rate (OSR): report.success == true, credited ONLY by the deterministic evidence oracle (verified non-FINISH trace observation), never by the agent's own claim.
scoring.validity_rule: infrastructure errors (crash/timeout/parse) are recorded as INVALID and excluded from OSR denominator, reported separately.
scoring.opportunity_parity_note: R1-B: base is HTTP-only and cannot run the browser verifier, so for browser-only effect classes it has no opportunity to be credited. The orchestration contrast of record is simple_tooled->full, where both arms have identical evidence opportunity.

reset_contract.order_policy: interleaved: arms run back-to-back on the SAME freshly-reset snapshot per (scenario,model,seed) unit, so no arm inherits another arm's residue (R1-E, R2-B identical state).

analysis_plan.pairing_unit: (scenario, model, seed) -- BETWEEN-arm paired on the SAME unit
analysis_plan.test: exact McNemar per contrast + scenario-cluster bootstrap CI
analysis_plan.multiplicity: report all three; Holm correction across the two orchestration contrasts (base__simple_tooled, simple_tooled__full) -- SET BY FREEZE
analysis_plan.dev_set_handling: K1 dev-set results reported separately, descriptive only; never pooled with confirmatory units.
